lines.text: A foolish woman tears her house down, and a fool's proud speech brings a rod to his back.
An abundant harvest comes through the strength of the ox, and a mocker seeks wisdom but finds none.
No stranger shares the heart's joy, and the wicked's house will be destroyed while the upright's tent flourishes.
The poor man is hated even by his brother, but many love the rich.
Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but the righteous man has a refuge even in sleep.
